Meet Tara

I help teams build the habits and systems that make effective delivery repeatable.

My work has included improving backlog refinement, coaching teams on story estimation and decomposition, clarifying definitions of done, introducing delivery metrics, and improving the use of Jira and Smartsheet.

At Georgetown, I helped transition the team from Trello to Jira, improve delivery practices, and reduce deployment bottlenecks through automation. I also introduced approaches to testing and knowledge sharing that supported more consistent engineering practices.

I measure success by whether teams gain the clarity, confidence, and autonomy to manage their work effectively.
